subject: SSO login fails for all users after IdP certificate rotation
description: Since the identity provider rotated its signing certificate on 14 October, every SAML login for Northwind Bank fails with 'invalid signature'. Users are locked out of the workflow portal.
comments: Engineering confirmed the old certificate is still cached in the SAML connector.
Workaround: admins can log in with break-glass accounts. Permanent fix is scheduled for 29 October.

subject: Nightly claims sync is 3 hours late
description: The Guidewire to data-warehouse pipeline for Fabrikam Insurance finished at 05:10 instead of 02:00 for three nights in a row. Morning claims dashboards show stale numbers.
comments: Root cause looks like an API rate limit on the Guidewire side after their upgrade.

subject: Question about exporting approval history
description: Contoso Retail finance wants a CSV export of every invoice approval from the last quarter for their auditors.
comments: Shared the audit export guide. Customer confirmed the export worked.
